descriptive_only: D16 float32/float64 have exact mergers, including same-b controls; D64 float64 has none. These arms do not change the prespecified D64 float32 verdict, and their distances or merger counts do not establish b information loss or presence.
interpretation: The registered main branch is INCONCLUSIVE: no new exact full-state merger was observed among 384 initially distinct opposite-b pairs in each D64 float32 seed. Distance shrank in opposite-b and same-b controls; a small nonzero distance does not establish loss or preservation of b information.
limits: The replay regenerates inputs and condition forward passes with the frozen implementation, then independently checks integer physics and raw-array reductions. It confirms this implementation and these conditional sampled trajectories, not all possible histories, alternative numerical kernels, a semantic code, a biological effect, or a topology mechanism.
scope: Independent result review of frozen paired-history diagnosis and one supervised numerical replay; no training, new sample, threshold change, or Gate 1 assessment.
